speaker: Doctor
text: Please describe the specific behaviors or beliefs you are experiencing regarding telepathic communication with animals. To help me understand the nature of this condition, have you noticed any changes in your hearing, vision, or sense of smell recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old male. The patient presents with a chief complaint of 'failing health.' He reports an inability to communicate telepathically with animals, which he believes he could previously do, affected by the current weather conditions. He has started taking assorted Peruvian herbs without any improvement. He denies taking any medications. The symptoms have been ongoing for the past eight months.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Delusional Disorder, Somatic Type (specifically a delusion of lost supernatural ability with secondary somatic delusion).
